youngearth: the world before the flood, a warm lush green earth of immense broadleaf forest and tree fern and cycad, vast open grasslands, wide slow rivers running full between green banks, rolling green hills under low warm hazy horizons, everything overgrown and fertile and dense with growth, soft humid air and bright warm daylight, unbroken wilderness
village: a small settlement of the line of Seth, low mud-brick and rough timber houses with flat roofs, open dirt yards, cooking fires, clay vessels, goat pens, hand tools of wood and bone and stone, modest and plain, built low into a green valley floor
highstone: a bare rock summit high above the valley, exposed grey stone slabs swept clean by wind, one broad flat ledge at the top, a small ring of dark fire stones, and below it on every side a warm green world of deep broadleaf forest and wide grassland and full slow rivers reaching to a hazy horizon, open sky overhead, temperate and lush and fertile
hut: the interior of a single-room Sethite dwelling, packed earth floor, mud-brick walls, low timber roof beams, one open doorway, woven mats and rough wool cloth, a single oil lamp, clay jars set against the wall
firsthome: the dwelling of the oldest man on earth, a single low house of large fitted grey stones under a heavy timber lintel, standing alone on open ground, one broad flat sitting-stone worn hollow beside the doorway, dry grass and scattered rock around it, an empty bright landscape reaching away on every side
firstman: an immensely old man, upright and clear-eyed, skin ridged and split like the bark of an ancient tree, a full white beard, pale steady eyes, heavy undyed wool robes, calm and unhurried, dignified and physically strong
eden: a primeval garden wilderness untouched by any hand, colossal ancient trees heavy with fruit standing over deep soft grass and dense flowering undergrowth, every leaf and stem and surface glowing as if lit from within with white-and-gold light, the air itself filled with an even unbroken radiance, rich saturated colour everywhere, trackless and overgrown and whole
city: the first city on earth, an immense walled Mesopotamian city of mud-brick and cut limestone rising straight out of a flat plain, flat-roofed buildings packed tight along narrow streets, stepped terraces and heavy timber gates, its people dark-haired and dark-eyed in draped linen and wool, scaffolds and new building spreading at the edges, black smoke standing in columns above the rooftops, dense and crowded and permanent
forge: a long open-sided metalworking shed of heavy timber posts and a soot-black roof, three brick furnaces roaring white-orange, stone anvils, wall racks of finished bronze, sand casting beds on the earth floor, ore baskets and charcoal heaps, the whole space lit by furnace glare
hermon: a colossal isolated mountain in the far north, a broad snow-covered summit above a hard tree line, bare grey rock faces and deep clean snowfields, brilliant thin high-altitude daylight, an immense sunlit world of plain and river visible far below on every side
watchers: enormous physical beings far larger than men, solid and opaque and heavy, dense mass with hard shadow beneath them and real weight pressing into whatever they stand on, austere still faces, plain heavy draped cloth covering them fully, upright and unhurried and monumental
nephilim: enormous physical giants far taller than any man, solid opaque bodies with real mass and hard shadow beneath them, heavy limbs and broad flat faces, rough hide and plain coarse cloth, upright and unhurried, pressing deep into whatever ground they stand on, monumental and incurious
cave: a low rock chamber cut back into a bare hillside, one narrow entrance admitting hard daylight, dry stone walls and a flat sand floor, rock ledges stacked with stretched marked hides bound in cord, a single clay oil lamp burning bright at the centre, deep shadow in the corners
lightcolumn: a colossal vertical shaft of brilliant white-and-gold light standing on the ground and rising unbroken into the sky, solid and defined with hard clean edges like a physical pillar, the rock at its base blazing lit, immense and still and weighted, a real structure of light rather than a haze or a beam
stonefield: the same bare rock summit later in its life, its broad flat ledge covered in hundreds of small flat pale stones laid out in long straight parallel rows running side by side across the rock like the furrows of a ploughed field, each stone set flat and level and touching the next, the oldest rows weathered grey and pitted and the newest still clean, a small ring of dark fire stones at one end, open sky above and a warm green world of forest and grassland falling away on every side
luminouschild: a healthy newborn infant whose skin gives off a soft clean white radiance from within, the complexion bright and warm with a rose flush, fine white hair, clear calm open eyes, wrapped in plain undyed brown wool, held in a bare mud-brick room with a packed earth floor and plain wool mats, the light coming off him steady and warm and gentle enough to fill the room, beautiful and peaceful and entirely human in form
ark: an enormous vessel of hewn timber standing on open cleared ground far from any water, three decks high and immensely long, built from massive irregular hand-hewn baulks and split planks with adzed faces and visible tool marks, tapered wooden pegs, black pitch worked into every seam, one large door in the side and one band of small openings near the roof line, rough timber scaffolds and stacks of split logs and pitch pots around its base, a warm green landscape of forest and grassland all around it
flood: an immense rising body of bright grey-white water covering an entire landscape, colossal moving walls and sheets of water catching hard daylight, brilliant white foam along every crest, hills and rooftops and fields disappearing beneath it, a heavy dark sky above with strong light breaking through onto the surface, vast and open and empty of people
elder: Methuselah in extreme old age, an immensely old man upright and unbroken, an immense full white beard and long white hair, skin very deeply weathered and sun-darkened and lined like old timber, hands broad and heavily veined and calloused, clear steady pale eyes, heavy dark undyed wool robes, monumental and dignified and physically strong
methuman: Methuselah in his prime, a strongly built man with a full dark beard and long dark hair, weathered sun-darkened skin, plain undyed wool robes and a worn leather cord at the throat, upright and unhurried, calm and watchful
methuboy: Methuselah as a child, a lean dark-haired boy with sun-darkened skin and dark deep-set eyes, plain rough wool tunic, barefoot, alert and serious
